spans.s:
Beach,Ⓒs.Ⓓ(samudra-)tIraM, kUlaM, velA, tawaM-wI.
Ⓝ[Beach]y,Ⓒa.Ⓓtawayukta, kUlamaya (yI f.).
Beacon,Ⓒs.ⒹAkASadIpaH, maholkA.

Bead,Ⓒs.ⒹgulI, guwikA; ‘a string of b(ead)s’ mAlA; hAraH; ‘a rosary of b(ead)s’; japa-akza-mAlA; ‘telling b(ead)s’ japamAlAM gaR 10.
Ⓝ[Bead]man,Ⓒs.ⒹjapakaraRe niyukto janaH.
Beadle,Ⓒs.ⒹdaMqaDaraH.

Beak,Ⓒs.ⒹcaMcu f., caMcUH, muKaM, tuMqaH-qaM.
Ⓝ[Beak]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹcaMcumat, tuMqayukta.
Ⓝ[Beak]er,Ⓒs.ⒹkAcapAtraM.

Beam,Ⓒs.ⒹtulA, sTURA; ‘of a balance’ daMqaH, yazwi f.; ‘of a carriage’ Dur f.
Ⓑ
 2 kiraRaH, aMSuH; See Ray.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓprot-vi-las 1 P, sPur 6 P; ‘a face b(eam)ing with joy’ mudA vilasadAnanaM.
Ⓝ[Beam]less,Ⓒa.ⒹnizpraBa, nistejas.
Ⓝ[Beam]y,Ⓒa.ⒹBAsvat, BAsura, dedIpyamAna, aMSumat.
Bean,Ⓒs.ⒹmAzaH, SiMbikaH.

Bear,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓvah 1 P, nI 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 Df 1 P, AlaMb 1 A, Bf 3 U (rAjyaBAramuvAha-baBAra).
Ⓑ
 3 sah 1 A, mfz 4 P, 10, kzam 1 A.
Ⓑ
 4 prasU 2 A; utpad c., jan c. (janayati); ‘Satyavati bore two sons to the king’ nfpeRa satyavatyAM putrO jAtO-utpAditO, nfpaH satyavatyAM putrAvajIjanat; the same sense ex. in sa nEzaDasya sutAyAM putramutpAdayAmAsa (R. xviii. 1) ‘he had a son by the daughter’ &c.
Ⓑ
 5 (Cherish) Bf 3 U, Df 1 P; ‘I b(ear) no malice to you’ tavopari dvezaM na DArayAmi, or na tvaM mama dvezapAtraM-sTAnaM; ‘he bore himself bravely on the occasion’ tasminnavasare tena sADu AcaritaM, DIraM vikAMtaM; ‘b(ear) witness’ sAkzyaM dA 3 P [] (with gen.); ‘b(ear) company’ sahacaraH (rI f.) BU 1 P; ‘b(ear) name’ nAma Bf 3 U, or Df 10; vyapadeSaM Baj 1 A; (evaMvyapadeSaBAjinaH

); ‘b(ear) fruit’ saPalIBU, Pal 1 P; ‘b(ear) in mind’ citte avaDf 10, manasi kf, anusmf 1 P.
Ⓔs.ⒹfkzaH, BallUkaH, BAlukaH.
ⓃBorn,Ⓒa.ⒹjAta, utpanna, prasUta, saMBUta; ‘to be b(orn)’ jan 4 A; utpad 4 A; prasU pass., udBU 1 P, saMBU; ‘was b(orn) in the form of a dwarf’ vAmanarUpeRa jAtaH-avatIrRaH.
Ⓝ[Bear] back,Ⓒv. i.ⒹparA-prati-ni-vft 1 A.
Ⓝ[Bear] down,Ⓒv. t.ⒹapAkf 8 U; parAji 1 A, nipat c.; ‘bore down all opposition’ sarvamaMtarAyamapAkurvan.
Ⓝ[Bear] on,Ⓒv. i.ⒹSee Apply.
Ⓝ[Bear] out,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓ(fig.) dfQayati (D.); samarT 10.
Ⓝ[Bear] up,Ⓒv.Ⓓudvah c., uttaMB c., as in Jawiti GawanottaMBitamiva (

).
Ⓑ
 2 sah 1 A; ‘b(ear up) under grief’ duHKapratikAraM kuru, SokavaSaM mA gamaH.
Ⓝ[Bear]er,Ⓒs.ⒹvAhaH, haraH, vAhakaH, in comp. vArtAharaH ‘b(earer) of news’
Ⓝ[Bear]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹavasTAnaM, sTiti f.
Ⓑ
 2 vftti f., vartanaM, AcaraRaM, rIti f.

Beard,Ⓒs.ⒹSmaSru n., kUrcaM; muKaroman n.; ‘wearing long b(eard)s’ dIrGakUrcAH (pl.).
Ⓑ
 2 SUkaM, kiMSAruH.
Ⓑ
 3 PalaM, karRaH.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓnyakkf 8 U, samakzaM avajYA 9 U or nirBarts 10 A or a-Dikzip 6 P.
Ⓝ[Beard]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹsaSmaSru; SmaSrula, kUrcaDara &c.
Ⓝ[Beard]less,Ⓒa.ⒹSmaSruhIna; ajAta-anudBinna-SmaSru.
Ⓑ
 2 aprAptavyavahAra.

Beast,Ⓒs.ⒹpaSuH, mfgaH, jaMtuH; ‘b(east) of prey’ SvApadaH; ‘b(east) of burden’ DuryaH, DurIRaH; ‘b(east) in the form of man’ narapaSuH.
Ⓝ[Beast]ful, [Beast]ly,Ⓒa.ⒹpaSutulya; jaGanya, paSuSIla.

Beat,Ⓒs.ⒹAGAtaH, prahAraH; tAqanaM.
Ⓑ
 2 spaMdanaM, sPuraRaM.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓtaq 10, prahf 1 P, tud 6 P, aBihan 2 P, Ahan 2 A, (AhatAyAM payARaBeryAM).
Ⓑ
 2 (defeat) viDvaMs c., BaMj 7 P, parAji 1 A, parABU 1 U.
Ⓑ
 3 Aluq c., cUrR 10.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹspaMd-kaMp-vep 1 A, sPur 6 P; ‘b(eat) very fast’ DamaDamAyate (D.).
Ⓝ[Beat] down,Ⓐnipat c.; (price) nyUnIkf.
Ⓝ[Beat] into,ⒶtAqanena kf or nirmA 3 A; ‘I shall b(eat) thee into a good boy’ tAqayitvA tAqayitvA tvAmahaM vidvAMsaM karizyAmi.
Ⓝ[Beat] off,Ⓐvidru c., pratihan.
Ⓝ[Beat] about the bush,Ⓐ(lit.) vanaM grah 9 P or Aluq 10; (fig.) aprastutamAlap 1 P; See Bush.

Beatify,Ⓒv. t.ⒹparamAnaMdaM dA 3 U.
Ⓑ
 2 amarezu gaRU 10, svargIyalokamaDye Aruh c.
Ⓝ[Beatif]ic,Ⓒa.Ⓓapavargada, mokzaprada.
Beatitude,Ⓒs.ⒹmokzaH, mukti f., niHSreyasaM, apavargaH, nirvARaM, paramA gatiH, kEvalyaM, ‘desirous of b(eautitude)’ mumukzuH.
Beau,Ⓒs.ⒹsuveSaH, suBagaMmanyaH.

Beauty,Ⓒs.ⒹsOMdaryaM, cArutA, lAvaRyaM, SoBA, kAMti f., rUpaM, ramaRIyatA, aBiKyA, manojYatvaM, SrIH, lakzmIH.
ⓃBeautify,Ⓒv. t.ⒹSuB c., BUz 10, alaMkf 8 U.
ⓃBeautiful, Beauteous,Ⓒa.ⒹsuMdara (rI f.), ramya, ramaRIya, kAMta, manojYa, surUpa, lAvaRyavat, rucira, SoBana, cAru (rvI f.), maMjula oft., by su in comp.; sumuKaM-susTalaM.
Ⓝ[Beautiful]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹsADu, suMdaraM, suzWu, su in comps.
Beaver,Ⓒs.ⒹSirastrARaBAgaH.
